01.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with T.R. Case No.31 of 2023 arising out of Mancheswar P.S. Case No.10 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar for offences punishable under sections 363/366/376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code read with section 6 of the POCSO Act.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Special Judge (POCSO) -cum- Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar vide order // 2 // dated 28.02.2023.

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO) -cum- Additional Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 21.01.2023 and in the meantime, on completion of investigation, charge sheet has been submitted under sections 363/366/376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code read with section 6 of the POCSO Act and after going through the statement of the victim and the medical examination report, which are filed by the learned counsel for the petitioner and taken on record and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.

sentences.text:
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper.
Accordingly, the BLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
